scenarios.title: Data Events
scenarios.description: Registers an event listener for barometer data and displays the pressure in hPa values as they are reported.

scenarios.title: Polling
scenarios.description: Polls for barometer data and displays the pressure in hPa values.

common_chrome: Scenario navigation list: '1) Data Events', '2) Polling'
hardware_note: Both apps require a barometer sensor. On this machine none is present, so all scenarios show 'No barometer found' and action buttons produce no live data in BOTH the UWP original and the WinUI 3 migration. This is hardware-gated, not a defect.
